## Two scientific layers and canonical ancestry

This reader covers **132 historical public canonical Agent-Oriented Software Engineering properties**. The canonical study reconciles two complete antecedents; it is not an extra set to add to them. Antecedent A's 113 and B's 83 property rows map into the canonical 132. The source/source-count distinction also matters: the canonical source table has 124 work/edition records. [Historical canonical report][report]

The separately accepted AMA-L3 scientific subject has SHA-256 `d60a32e34fc19d30f4b41272a1883a514daebec22196f448b3528b87b80f25fa` and again selects 132 property identities. Its exact current source repairs, new adjudications and independent review findings are retained privately with the accepted subject. They are not silently applied to the original rows. [SOURCE_MAP.json](SOURCE_MAP.json) records the four-unit bindings. `AMA-DISCLOSE-AMA-L3` remains **PENDING**.

## What AOSE contributes

Agent-Oriented Software Engineering uses intentional responsibilities, goals, roles, interactions and organizations as subjects of requirements, analysis, design, implementation and change. It is broader than an agent runtime and different from using an agent to generate code. A strategic actor in a requirements model need not become a runtime agent. Conventional services and objects remain legitimate implementations when they meet the actual obligations. [Historical public intake][intake]

The genealogy includes intentional programming and BDI foundations; actor/goal/dependency requirements; Gaia's role-oriented analysis and design; Tropos; MaSE/O-MaSE; Prometheus; compositional and knowledge-oriented methods; method engineering; public commitments; and later temporal, normative and generative hybrids. These are distinct methodological choices. A shared name or later framework branding does not establish full inheritance or a single compulsory lifecycle. Canonical reconciliation retains each A/B ancestry, its actual contribution and source ceiling. [Historical coverage][coverage] · [Canonical reconciliation][reconciliation]

The first sharp predicate is **affected-stakeholder validation**, C001: diagrams do not establish that all relevant people or dependencies were discovered. C002 connects requirements to acceptance; C006/007 distinguish delegation from an actor's current practical ability and permission; C020–025 concern roles, holders, organization and progress. A role can be present while the incumbent lacks capacity or authority. A valid organizational successor can still lose a predecessor's live obligation. [C001–C011, C020–C025, C105][ledger]

Interaction engineering must keep meaning, authentication, authorization, public obligations and external effect distinct. C036 rejects inaccessible private mental states as a sufficient public-compliance test; C037 preserves a separately guarded controlled/private-state branch. Their different polarities survive the canonical population. A norm or contract can define a responsibility without causing performance. A timeout can leave an effect uncertain, and retries can duplicate effects. [C033–C043, C109][ledger]

## Assurance and composition have specific subjects

A model proof establishes its scoped proposition under the model's premises. A transformation preserves a specified relation between supported representations. A test supplies evidence at its oracle and observation scope. None establishes the legitimacy of the requirement, every environment assumption or physical enactment by mere coexistence. Conversely, an adequate atomic interface can provide a useful warrant without a second independent implementation. [C058–C061, C081–C098][ledger]

C086's compatible-support criterion requires the relevant warrants to join the same subject, principal, action, configuration and acceptance context. Correctly authorizing a refund to B does not meet A's distinct requirement. Pairwise satisfiable fragments need not have a common global witness; shared resource budgets can fail after individually feasible tasks are combined. An adequate direct check can discharge a small join, and conventional implementation remains a valid branch. These are bounded analytical distinctions rather than a new universal proof system. [C054–C064, C079, C086 and canonical composition][composition]

Change and operation require actual consumers. A log no decision maker can use is not complete feedback. A changed premise can invalidate dependent evidence while leaving independent evidence intact. Changing role holders does not automatically transfer promises. C103/105/106 separate those obligations, with selective revalidation and omission when no affected dependency exists. [Historical ledger][ledger]

## Generated roles and plans retain external obligations

The canonical population sharply distinguishes C123's retained role-contract boundary, C131's rejected prompt/contract equivalence and C132's rejected claim that role prompts alone constitute AOSE. C125 preserves actual tool authority. C129 concerns operational planning semantics. C130 concerns responsiveness while generation is pending; the source-grounded guidance is not a general response-time, fairness or deadline guarantee. These meanings are not interchangeable. [C123–C132][ledger] · [Historical public intake][intake]

## Alternatives, negatives and remaining science

Ten historical configuration branches range from conventional software and AO analysis with ordinary execution to BDI, cooperative organization, public commitments, adaptive organization, specialized cooperative/holonic arrangements, stronger assurance, generative hybrids and minimum coherent engineering. These are guarded choices, not a checklist to instantiate together. Complete-method superiority remains unresolved in two distinct rows: C119 for the evolved configuration family and C120 for broad complete AOSE methods. Local successes, source counts and benchmark reuse do not settle either; absence of superiority evidence is not evidence that every mechanism is inferior. [Canonical composition][composition] · [C119/120][ledger]

Canonical reconciliation admits no distinct new induced property. Its retained relation bundles and negative candidate decisions remain useful scientific outputs. Historical duplicate names and nested ancestral representations do not multiply independent mechanisms. The row reader retains A/B ancestry, canonical disposition and criterion, including negative, contested and unresolved records. The full nested originals remain in the immutable public corpus. [Canonical reconciliation][reconciliation]

## Separate native responsibility

Published, canonically unallocated **R0043 / #232** has a separate bounded EAOSE-132 documentary receiving record and an embedded AMA-continuation receiving scope. Neither closes the other simply through sharing an issue. The native source preserves original, older target, later prepared target and actual documentary decisions as separate layers. Runtime implementation is not earned by a route or property count. [Existing qualification][native]

The AMA-L3 rough responsibility focuses on exact requirements/implementation/evidence correspondence, live responsibility during change and the current native consumer. R002D/#197 retains systems/interfaces/model-credibility ownership; R0037/#211 retains whole control composition; R0033/#207, R0035/#209 and R0036/#210 preserve their own authority/join/lane boundaries. R001F/#158 governs any later authorized executor-ready residual. [Owner map](OWNER_MAP.json) · [Four rough responsibilities](RLGWO_OUTLINES.md)

**Canonical A ancestry:** A:EAOSE-001; A:EAOSE-042

**Canonical B ancestry:** B:EAOSE-001

**Reconciliation:** Both procedures elicit and challenge the affected-actor boundary rather than infer validity from a goal diagram. **Authority boundary:** Legitimate stakeholders and responsible authorities set constraints; agents cannot trade away non-delegable limits merely because a utility score improves.

**Problem:** Systems where roles, norms, resource operations and individual plans evolve independently.

**Authority boundary:** Security administrators or legitimate principals establish identity and authority; agents cannot grant trust merely by accepting a name in an ACL field.

**Evolved form at historical freeze:** Associate decision-relevant beliefs with observations or derivations, update and defeat conditions, and unresolved uncertainty. Do not promote an agent's stored belief into an external fact simply because it has a symbolic label or a fluent explanation.

**Problem:** Agents whose observations become stale, conflict or are derived from fallible models.

**Mechanism:** Associate decision-relevant beliefs with observations or derivations, update and defeat conditions, and unresolved uncertainty. Do not promote an agent's stored belief into an external fact simply because it has a symbolic label or a fluent explanation.

**Trigger and context:** Agents whose observations become stale, conflict or are derived from fallible models.

**Development:** A extracts bounded reconsideration and useful intention persistence. B concurrency/interference is a different scheduling problem; a stable intention policy can still interfere with another intention.

**Evolved form at historical freeze:** Retain an adopted intention long enough to coordinate useful action, with explicit reconsideration when achievement, impossibility, irrelevance or competing obligations warrant it; account for the cost of reconsideration itself.

**Problem:** Long-lived, interruptible or resource-bounded goal pursuit where continual replanning or blind persistence causes harm.

**Mechanism:** Retain an adopted intention long enough to coordinate useful action, with explicit reconsideration when achievement, impossibility, irrelevance or competing obligations warrant it; account for the cost of reconsideration itself.

**Trigger and context:** Long-lived, interruptible or resource-bounded goal pursuit where continual replanning or blind persistence causes harm.

**Preconditions:** DATA: The chosen executable semantics, actual internal/environment state, candidate actions/plans, implementation artefacts and relevant resource/timing conditions.; PROPERTY_DEPENDENCIES: []; SPECIFIC_PRECONDITIONS: Defined achievement and abandonment conditions, observation of relevant changes, resource bounds and authority to change commitments.

**Decision or consumer:** Agent designers choose reconsideration policy within stakeholder priorities; the acting agent cannot silently abandon public commitments merely by dropping an internal intention.

**Authority boundary:** Agent designers choose reconsideration policy within stakeholder priorities; the acting agent cannot silently abandon public commitments merely by dropping an internal intention.

**Communication or interaction:** Communicate the decision-relevant result to its actual consumer: Agent designers choose reconsideration policy within stakeholder priorities; the acting agent cannot silently abandon public commitments merely by dropping an internal intention. The operative evidence is: The system can explain why pursuit continued, was suspended or was abandoned, and what happened to dependent obligations. This is not a requirement for a new message protocol when an existing shared representation suffices.

**Observable criterion:** The system can explain why pursuit continued, was suspended or was abandoned, and what happened to dependent obligations.

**Nontrigger or cheaper adequate path:** A one-shot deterministic operation may need no persistent intention state; a standard job lifecycle can implement the necessary persistence.

**Historical disposition:** CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

**Failure modes:** Overcommitment wastes resources; excessive reconsideration thrashes. Philosophical and formal motivation does not establish an optimal policy in every environment.

**Trigger and context:** Work crosses development, testing, operation or affected-user boundaries.
